name: The Trainer
description: The Trainer of the game theory videos: low, flat and unhurried, never surprised. Voice 1 of three and pace 2 of three, picked by Biku on 2026-10-11; on 2026-10-13 he picked the blend, seven parts of that voice to three of the plain narrator, so the Trainer sounds like nobody else. Spoken by Chatterbox from a sample of this Kokoro voice since 2026-10-14, so it is the same person, more alive.
